explanation: The statement says the finrank over v.Completion of the product of w.Completion over the library-defined type `v.Extension L` equals [L:K]. Mathlib has `InfinitePlace.sum_inertiaDeg_eq_finrank` and `inertiaDeg_eq_finrank` in NumberTheory/NumberField/Completion/Ramification.lean. The library's proof uses both. They only give the sum over `placesOver L v` of the finranks. They say nothing about the Pi module. Mathlib has no `InfinitePlace.Extension` type, and I found no Pi-completion finrank lemma. The step from the sum to the Pi module needs an equivalence between `v.Extension L` and the `placesOver` subtype, plus `Module.finrank_pi_fintype`, so it is more than a one- or two-line instantiation.
